_readme: Queue for the n8n 'FollowNet Blog' workflow. It takes the first topic whose slug is not yet in content/blog-auto/, writes the article (EN, then ru/uk/de/es/fr/pt) and commits content/blog-auto/<slug>.json. Add topics at the end; 'query' is the search phrase people type, 'brief' is what the article must cover. shots = two names from src/assets/screenshots/v2 (ios-autoconnect, ios-connected, ios-disconnected, ios-dns, ios-profiles, ios-protocol, ios-servers, ios-settings, ios-speed, ios-split, ext-connected, ext-servers).

topics.brief: What can actually go wrong on hotel Wi-Fi (shared network, fake hotspots with the same name, captive portals), a 5-step checklist for the first minute after connecting, and where a VPN helps vs. does not.

topics.query: how to use airport wifi safely
topics.brief: Practical airport Wi-Fi routine: pick the official network, finish the captive portal, then connect the VPN; set Auto-connect to Wi-Fi only so it happens without thinking; what to avoid (banking on unknown networks without HTTPS checks, auto-join).

Why a VPN uses some battery, which factors matter (protocol, distance to server, Always-on with weak signal), and concrete settings that reduce drain: WireGuard, nearest server, Auto-connect on Wi-Fi only.

Step-by-step troubleshooting when the internet is slow with a VPN: run a speed test with and without, pick the closest server, try another protocol, check if the slowdown is the Wi-Fi itself. No speed numbers.
Honest comparison of WireGuard and IKEv2 on iPhone/Mac: handoffs between Wi-Fi and LTE, battery, reconnection, when each is the better pick, and why Smart mode exists.

topics.query: what is a vpn kill switch
topics.brief: What a kill switch does, when it matters (unexpected drops on public Wi-Fi), the trade-off (no internet until the tunnel is back), and how FollowNet's behaves: blocks only on unexpected drops, manual Disconnect restores internet.
Split tunneling in plain words, typical uses (local services, sites that dislike VPN IPs, saving traffic), the privacy trade-off, and how to set it up on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

topics.query: how to check if vpn is working
topics.brief: Simple checks anyone can do: the VPN icon in the status bar, visible IP and country on an IP lookup site, DNS leak test sites, what results mean and what to do if something looks wrong.
What DNS is, what a DNS leak reveals, how to test for it, and how choosing a DNS preset inside the VPN (Cloudflare, Quad9, AdGuard) avoids it.

topics.query: how to set up vpn on mac
topics.brief: Setting up a VPN on a Mac from the App Store: install, allow the VPN configuration, choose protocol and server, auto-connect; difference between a Mac app and a browser extension.

topics.query: how to set up vpn on android
topics.brief: Installing and configuring a VPN app on Android: permissions prompt, choosing a server, Always-on VPN in Android settings, what the key icon means, battery optimisation exceptions.
Using a VPN on iPad: same account as iPhone, device limits, auto-connect for travel, widgets and Shortcuts on iPad.
What a browser extension protects (only that browser's traffic) vs. a full VPN app (the whole device), when an extension is enough, and why both can share one account.

How to judge a free VPN: who runs it, business model, permissions, clear limits instead of hidden ones; why a capped free tier from a paid product is a different model than ad-funded free VPNs. No attacks on named competitors.

topics.query: should i use a vpn when traveling abroad
topics.brief: Travel routine: install and log in before the trip, test on home Wi-Fi, Travel profile, roaming between hotel Wi-Fi and local SIM, what to do if one protocol does not connect on a new network (Smart mode tries others).

topics.query: is it safe to use banking app with vpn
topics.brief: Using banking apps with a VPN: why some banks flag unfamiliar IPs, picking a server in your own country, split tunneling for a bank site, and why HTTPS plus a VPN on public Wi-Fi is sensible. No promises about any specific bank.
Remote work from cafés and coworkings: shared networks, video calls over a VPN (UDP protocols, nearest server), auto-connect rules, and when the company's own VPN is required instead.

topics.query: do i need a vpn on mobile data
topics.brief: Is mobile data safer than Wi-Fi, what the carrier can still see, when a VPN on LTE/5G makes sense, and how to set Auto-connect to mobile data only or Always.
Clear table-in-words: what a VPN hides from the local network and ISP, what websites still see (logins, cookies, browser fingerprint), and what the VPN provider sees. Honest limits.

topics.query: what can someone do with my ip address
topics.brief: What an IP address reveals (approximate location, provider), what it does not, realistic risks, and how a VPN replaces the visible IP with the server's.
Ping and VPNs: why the route length matters, choosing the closest server, UDP protocols, when a VPN adds latency and when it can help on a congested Wi-Fi. No ping numbers promised.
Troubleshooting checklist: captive portal not finished, network blocks VPN ports, switch protocol (Hysteria2/AmneziaWG/IKEv2), switch server, restart Wi-Fi; how Smart Connect automates the fallback.

AmneziaWG in plain words: WireGuard with traffic that looks less like a typical VPN to network filters, when it helps (networks that drop standard VPN handshakes), trade-offs, how to pick it in the app.
Hysteria2 explained: QUIC over UDP, why it copes with packet loss and long distances, when it is the right pick, when UDP is blocked and another protocol is better.
Comparing DNS presets available in the app: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9 (malware filtering), AdGuard (ads), AdGuard Family; who each suits; DNS inside the VPN vs. system DNS.

topics.query: block ads on iphone without app
topics.brief: How DNS-based ad blocking works, what it can and cannot block (in-app ads served from the same domain), AdGuard DNS preset, and ad blocking in the Chrome extension.
Family filtering via DNS: what AdGuard Family filters, limits (not a full parental control), combining with Screen Time; setting it as part of a network profile.

topics.query: iphone shortcut turn on vpn automatically
topics.brief: Apple Shortcuts automations with FollowNet actions: connect when leaving home, apply the Travel profile when joining a hotel network, disconnect at home; step-by-step.
Controlling the VPN without opening the app: Control Center control, Home Screen widget, Live Activity on the Lock Screen; how to add each one.

topics.query: one vpn for iphone mac and android
topics.brief: Using one account on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Chrome: passwordless login, how Premium devices are counted (up to 5), freeing a device you no longer use.
Campus and dorm Wi-Fi: shared networks, respecting the university's rules, privacy from other users on the network, protocols that work on restrictive networks, free plan as a start.

topics.query: secure video call on public wifi
topics.brief: Video calls over public Wi-Fi with a VPN: latency, choosing a nearby server and a UDP protocol, what end-to-end encryption in the call app already covers, and what the VPN adds.

topics.query: how to spot fake wifi hotspot
topics.brief: Evil-twin hotspots: how they look, signs of a fake network, asking staff for the exact name, turning off auto-join for open networks, and why a VPN limits the damage.
Seven common VPN myths (makes you anonymous, stops viruses, always slow, only for tech people, etc.) with short honest answers.
VPN on a home router vs. on each device: coverage, speed, flexibility, when per-device apps are simpler, LAN devices and split tunneling.
Plain-language glossary: tunnel, protocol, handshake, DNS, IP, kill switch, split tunneling, server location, latency, jitter, UDP vs TCP.
